journey.title: Tab stays inside the upload dialog when it contains a hidden button
journey.goal: Tabbing past the last visible control wraps to the start of the dialog

plan.root_cause: The MicroModal library's getFocusableNodes() method includes hidden elements (display: none) in the focusable nodes list, causing the focus trap to incorrectly calculate the last focusable element and fail to wrap focus to the first dialog element when tabbing past the last visible control.
plan.repair_strategy: Modify getFocusableNodes() to filter out elements that are not visually rendered (offsetParent === null) or have aria-hidden='true', ensuring only visible, accessible elements participate in the focus trap.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Tab key navigation will cycle within the dialog's visible controls (Close, File name, Upload) instead of escaping to external links, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 and 2.4.3 for keyboard focus containment.
functional_risks: If offsetParent check is too aggressive, it might exclude elements positioned off-screen but still focusable; however, display:none elements are correctly excluded.
Elements with visibility:hidden or opacity:0 but display:block would still be included; this matches current behavior and is acceptable for a minimal fix.
verification_requirements: Tab from Upload button wraps focus to Close button (or File name input) inside dialog
Shift+Tab from first focusable element wraps to last visible element
Escape key closes dialog and returns focus to trigger
Upload button click updates status and closes dialog
